subject: Go-live runway + ops handoff — NovaCorp implementation plan
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novacorp.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwoodai.com>
Cc: NovaCorp Implementation Team <impl-team@novacorp.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff -> mutual action plan and proposed milestones

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the demo today — team was impressed with the latency/cost benchmarks. We need to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and go-live runway so our engineering and security teams can align with internal milestones.

High level asks from our side:
- A draft MAP with milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria
- Rough timeline to pilot (UAT window and production cutover)
- Any compliance artifacts required for our security review (SOC 2 summary, data retention notes)

Can you send a draft by end of week? We have an internal milestone on 2026-12-10 where we need Redwood available in our staging cluster.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Platform Integrations
NovaCorp
From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwoodai.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novacorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 17:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff -> mutual action plan and proposed milestones

Hi Marta — great to meet you earlier. Attaching a first-pass MAP (Novacorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) that maps milestones to owners and acceptance criteria. Quick notes:

- Pilot scope: embeddings-based search + conversational query layer (we'll scope tokens and throughput during sprint zero)
- Proposed UAT window: 2026-11-28 to 2026-12-05
- Prod cutover target: 2026-12-10 (per your ask)
- Owner breakdown included in sheet tab "RACI" — default owners: Aisha (Redwood PM), Marissa (Customer Success lead), Karthik (Solutions / infra).

Next steps I propose this week:
1) Internal Redwood: Marissa and Karthik to confirm resource availability and add specific dates to the calendar.
2) NovaCorp: confirm internal stakeholders for security review and infra access.
3) Joint: 30-min alignment call Thursday to lock UAT test cases and SSO access plan.

Can you confirm availability for Thu 11/12 10:00 PT?

Attachments: Novacorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwoodai.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@novacorp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff -> mutual action plan and proposed milestones

Thanks Aisha. I reviewed the draft and added concrete milestone dates and owners in the attached calendar (implementation_calendar.ics) and updated the MAP tab "Milestones" with acceptance criteria. Key callouts below:

- Sprint zero (integration prep): 11/15 - 11/22 — owner: Karthik (Redwood Solutions). Deliverables: VPC peering request, test credentials, sample dataset push.
- UAT (functional): 11/28 - 12/05 — owner: NovaCorp QA with Redwood test plan. Entry criteria: successful ingest of 10k doc set, 95% of smoke tests pass.
- Production cutover: 12/10 — owner: NovaCorp infra with Redwood on-call. Rollback plan included in MAP.

Also attaching SLA_Summary.pdf with typical latency and uptime SLOs we can commit to for Dedicated vs Hosted (summary page).

Ask NovaCorp: please confirm who will own the acceptance sign-off on 12/06 so we can hold the cutover window.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta@novacorp.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwoodai.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 08:38:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff -> mutual action plan and proposed milestones

Aisha / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround. A few items from our security and infra leads:

- Security wants the SOC 2 scoping note and a short paragraph about data retention and KV cache behavior (how long prefixes are retained). Can you add that to the MAP doc?
- Our infra lead (Ravi) asked whether Redwood will require direct VPC peering or if a secure egress and NAT will be sufficient for the pilot.
- Acceptance sign-off: I'll own final sign-off for functional UAT; Ravi will own infra readiness sign-off on 12/08.

We can do Thu 11/12 10:00 PT for the alignment call — sending calendar invite now.

— Marta
From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwoodai.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@novacorp.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodai.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff -> mutual action plan and proposed milestones

Great — thanks for confirming owners, Marta. Follow-up items from our side and updated commitments: 

- I've updated the MAP with a new tab "Compliance & Data" that includes the SOC 2 scoping note, KV cache retention behavior (default TTL noted), and a data retention summary. See Novacorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx v1.1 (I attached a copy to the shared HubSpot record).
- On VPC: Karthik confirms both options supported. For pilot we recommend secure egress + NAT (lower lift); if you want dedicated network we can provision VPC peering during the sprint zero timeline but that adds ~3 business days to setup.
- Meeting Thursday 11/12 10:00 PT — agenda: SSO + infra access, UAT success criteria, test data handoff.

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: push v1.1 MAP to HubSpot (HS-129473) and share DocuSign envelope for statements of work (DEAL-8341).
- Marissa: coordinate Redwood test plan and on-call rota for cutover.
- Karthik: create VPC-options doc and recommended commands for secure egress.
- Marta / Ravi: confirm infra contact list and whether peering is required by 11/17.

Please reply with a quick "ack" if this looks good and we'll treat 12/10 as the hard cutover target pending UAT.

Thanks all,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Novacorp_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (updated v1.1)
